reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY parent_category
alternatives: SELECT parent_category, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024_eur, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_eur FROM sales GROUP BY parent_category

SELECT parent_category, COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'), 0) AS revenue_2024_eur, COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'), 0) AS revenue_2025_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1
